info.wans_minego_expansion.attune: Hold an Empty Soul Stone and sneak-right-click a block in one of the biomes below. In survival, one empty stone is consumed to produce an attuned stone.
info.wans_minego_expansion.attune_result: An attuned stone is a crafting ingredient. It cannot be equipped or attuned again. Use its crafting recipe to make the corresponding biome soul stone.
info.wans_minego_expansion.proof_kills: Kill the following creatures %s times in total to receive one proof. Creatures in the same group share a counter.
info.wans_minego_expansion.proof_credit: Kills must be credited to the player or their summons. Allied targets do not count.
info.wans_minego_expansion.proof_explore: Stay continuously in any biome below for at least %s seconds. The first completion of each biome in the current cycle awards one exploration proof.
info.wans_minego_expansion.proof_complet: Stay continuously in each of the eight biomes below for at least %s seconds. Completing the cycle awards one complete exploration proof.
info.wans_minego_expansion.proof_cycle: Completing all eight biomes resets the cycle. Changing biomes resets the current stay timer.
info.wans_minego_expansion.config: Counts and durations use the current soul-stone configuration. Server settings apply in multiplayer.
